name: Hakosaki Chisa
source:
Hobbies: Internet, reading.
Likes: Animals in general, sweets.
Hates: Waterside.

Chisa is a second year student at Sumisora High School and [url=/c13501]Ririsu[/url]'s best friend. She has a crush on [url=/c13500]Shio[/url] and confesses to him at the beginning of the story.

In Memories Off 6: Next Relation:
A third year student at Sumisora High School.
